purpose.zh: 练侧向开腿末端的主动控制
purpose.en: Build active control at the end of the side-split range.

text.zh: 腿伸直向侧滑出，再用大腿内侧拉回
text.en: Slide the straight leg out to the side, then pull it back with your inner thigh

text.zh: 一脚踩滑垫，另一侧膝盖弯曲、臀部后坐
text.en: One foot on the slider, bend the other knee and sit your hips back.

text.zh: 滑到能控制的距离停住，不要硬撑
text.en: Stop at a distance you can control; do not force it.

commonErrors.en: Sliding too far and losing control.
Letting the standing knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧或膝盖疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your inner thigh or knee hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
